name: Data Analyst
description: Interprets data and turns it into information which can offer ways to improve a business.

name: Data Engineer
description: Builds systems that collect, manage, and convert raw data into usable information.

name: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Creates programs and algorithms that enable machines to take actions without direction.

name: AI Engineer
description: Builds AI models using machine learning algorithms and deep learning neural networks.

name: Data Scientist
description: Analyzes and interprets complex data to help organizations make decisions.

name: Business Analyst
description: Analyzes business processes and creates solutions.

name: Frontend Developer
description: Builds the user-facing portion of websites and web applications.

name: Backend Developer
description: Builds the server-side functionality of websites and web applications.

name: Full Stack Developer
description: Develops both client and server software.

name: Game Developer
description: Creates video games for various platforms.

name: DevOps Engineer

name: Cloud Architect

name: Security Engineer
description: Builds security systems for an organization.
